import pytest
from auth.service import User, Org, remove_member, PermissionDeniedError


def test_non_admin_cannot_remove_member():
    actor = User(id="u2", role="member")
    org = Org(id="o1", members=["u2", "u3"])
    with pytest.raises(PermissionDeniedError):
        remove_member(actor, org, "u3")
    assert org.members == ["u2", "u3"]
explanation: Constructs the non-admin actor the requirement names and asserts remove_member rejects it and leaves membership unchanged. No existing test uses a non-admin actor, which is why removing the guard survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(PermissionDeniedError) on a member-role actor is the assertion that detects the missing admin guard.
